sloka: स्रजश्च सर्वरत्नानि प्रिया याश्च वराङ्गनाः ।ऐश्वर्यं च विशालायां पृथिव्यामपि दुर्लभम् ।। ५.३८.५७।।।।
transliteration: srajaśca sarvaratnāni priyā yāśca varāṅganāḥ ।aiśvaryaṁ ca viśālāyāṁ pṛthivyāmapi durlabham ।। 5.38.57।।।।

translations.english: He by whom Sumitra became a blessed mother—who, honouring and gladly taking leave of his father and mother, renounced garlands, all jewels, beloved women, and a sovereignty rare upon this vast earth to follow Rama into exile.
